title: Surf Paddle-to-Wave Conversion
dataSources: E-bike rides (`ebike:ride`), scooter trips (`scooter:trip`), skate sessions (`skate:session`), surf sessions (`surf:session`), snow runs (`snow:run`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sport trackers — e-bike / e-scooter apps (VanMoof, Bosch eBike Flow), and skate / surf / snow session trackers (Trace, Slopes, Xensr) with IMU sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=surf:session
| stats avg(waves_caught) as avg_waves, avg(paddle_attempts) as avg_paddles, count as sessions by board
| eval conversion_pct=round(100*avg_waves/avg_paddles,1)
| sort - conversion_pct
description: Measures how efficiently paddling attempts are turning into caught waves.
value: Conversion is a better skill signal than raw wave count because conditions can inflate or deflate the total.
implementation: Send surf-session summaries with board, wave count, and paddle attempts to `index=personal`; compare conversion by board.
visualization: Board table of average waves, paddle attempts, and conversion percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks how often your paddling efforts actually turn into caught waves instead of tired arms.
